text: Place a glass of water beside your bed tonight. Tomorrow morning you will understand why. This is one of the oldest cleansing practices that exist. Simple, silent, and incredibly powerful. Before you sleep, take a clear glass and fill it with clean water. Hold it with both hands. Close your eyes and say quietly, while I rest, cleanse what I cannot see. Absorb what is heavy. Remove what is not mine. You are giving the water an instruction. You are telling it what to do while you sleep. Water is the most receptive element in nature. It responds to the intention of whoever touches it. After speaking, place the glass beside your bed and sleep normally. Now pay attention to what happens in the morning. Look at the water, but do not rush. If it is full of bubbles, as if it had been boiling during the night, the space where you sleep is carrying something heavy. The water pulled it out of the air around you. If the water is cloudy or looks nothing like it did when you placed it there, the weight is even deeper. Weeks, maybe months of tension, stress, and energy that was never yours to carry. If the water is still clean and clear, your space is light and the energy is flowing. Whatever happens, never drink it. That water did its job. Throw it away and wash the glass under running water. If the water does not come out clean after the first night, do it for seven nights in a row. Watch the pattern and do not be afraid of what you find. Be afraid of how long you have been sleeping next to that energy without knowing it. Not all exhaustion comes from the body, my friend. Sometimes what weighs you down is invisible, but you feel it every single morning. Write in the comments, I will do it today, if you are going to try this tonight and come back tomorrow to tell me what you found in the glass. If you are tired of needing rituals every time something feels heavy. If you want to learn how to stay clean, light, and at peace every day, without depending on any of this, I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that, and everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
